profile.headline: Systems/Simulation Testing @ NVIDIA
profile.summary:
Systems engineer at Cruise with a focus in safety testing & robotics.

Former Business Technology Analyst at Deloitte Digital. Graduate of Duke University’s Pratt School of Engineering with Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science major, Computer Science minor. 

Passionate about the future of mobility and transportation in smart cities, software engineering & writing beautiful/elegant code, sustainability, education, astronomy, soccer, and music. 

How can I leave the earth in a better state than it was when I was born? That is my mission statement for now. Excited to use the skills I've learned to help others!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Simulation Test Engineering
Senior Software Engineer - Simulation Test Engineering
Business Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Served in 2 separate projects over the course of 18 months.

Second project: Scrum Master for standing up new content management system. Responsible for managing scrum board as well as working closely with the client to gather requirements for the CMS and working closely with the engineers to remove any functional barriers that may be present. Day-to-day tasks also involve meeting with designers to talk about new functionality, capturing requirements through writing user stories, and meeting with the product owners to determine priority level of new features. 

First project: responsible for assisting in a re-design of automated terminations and cancellations process. Involved in design workshops to create the solution, then worked with technical resources to create the required code changes and bring the solution through intensive testing and to production.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Planned weekly community-building events for first-year students in Bassett Residence Hall (during my sophomore year) and then for members of SAE Fraternity (during junior and senior years). 

Developed effective communication skills to engage in conflict resolution with peers.

In charge of managing the budget for activities and meeting with the Graduate Resident twice every month to deliver financial update. 

Enforced housing policies when necessary.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Robotics Laboratory
positions.description:
Working with Dr. Michael Zavlanos to develop new algorithms for intermittent communication for teams of mobile robots.

Translating and coding previously devised linear temporal logic formulas into team repository (C++).

positions.title: Mechatronics Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Selected as one of top students from mechatronics course in Spring 2016.

Assisted undergraduates with lab section by guiding students through experiments, providing feedback on lab reports, helping with design requirements, and answering any questions about the material that may be misunderstood.

Graded and returned homework and lab reports to provide constant feedback for the students.

Held weekly office hours to answer questions about the material covered in class and provided guidance for approaches to homework problems and lab reports.

positions.title: Firmware Integration Intern
positions.description:
Designed and built portable firmware downloading station in order to help diagnostic team conduct firmware validation trials on entire instrument panel sub-assembly line and final line of Model S & X

Collaborated with 100+ firmware engineers, manufacturing engineers, and technicians to validate completed firmware packages on first 30 Model 3’s as well as perform root cause analysis for failures

Developed new feature on diagnostic application for technicians that allows quick access to repair a vehicle if segment of FW download was skipped (Python); saves average of 17.5 minutes of vehicle “dead” time per instance

positions.title: iOS Development Intern
positions.description:
Implemented major design changes to BMW's Driver's Guide 2.0 iPhone app, and fixed over 20 major and minor bugs.

Acquired significant experience with Swift and Objective-C in fast-paced work environment.

Learned to code CSS and HTML to change the layout of multiple webview pages with the application.

Worked with the team's build leader to gather deliverables for weekly meeting with product owners in Germany.

volunteerExperiences.description: Delivered meals for the elderly during CoVID-19 crisis for up to 20hrs/week.

volunteerExperiences.role: Social Impact Co-Chair of BTA Advisory Council
volunteerExperiences.description:
Built 4+ dashboards to provide insights to customer behaviors for a Panama City-based startup and delivered detailed documentation for interpretation and continued use of accumulated data (SQL).

Organized 5+ pro-bono consulting projects to help solve local (NYC) nonprofits’ technology challenges.

projects.title: The Allyship Corner
projects.description: A JavaScript-Rails single page application that provides the ability to find events for allies to support oppressed minority groups.

projects.title: CoVID Community Food Bank
projects.description: Interactive Ruby on Rails application for community members to connect with volunteers about food deliveries during the COVID-19 crisis.
